articles.title: Climate Talks End With No Deal After Two Long Weeks
articles.summary: COP31 in Turkey ended with no agreement after countries rejected a draft that left out fossil fuels, the first failed UN climate talks since 2009.

articles.title: Delta Delays Pile Up After a Computer Glitch on a Busy Travel Day
articles.summary: A problem with a system that calculates plane weight delayed about 1,000 Delta flights on Sunday, days before Thanksgiving.

articles.title: Thanksgiving Dinner: Will It Cost More This Year? It Depends Who You Ask
articles.summary: Grocery prices are up nearly 22 percent over five years, but two estimates disagree on whether this year's Thanksgiving meal will cost more than last year's.
